name: slider
title: Slider
description: A slider whose thumb grows while held and springs back on release, settling on the nearest step. A bubble shows the value through your formatter and stays inside the slider at the ends. WAI-ARIA slider keys (arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End) and pointer capture for mouse, pen and touch.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Slider from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/motion-slider".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-slider.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createSlider on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/slider/slider.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#slider
